mapper.select: SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name_all_path , apr01_title AS title , f_emp_kor_nm(emp00_person_id) AS reg_emp_name , emp00_org_kor_nm AS org_name FROM apr01_appr , dcr01_class_tree , emp00_trans_info WHERE apr01_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND apr01_reg_emp_id = emp00_person_id AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN emp00_trans_date AND coalesce(emp00_close_date, to_date('29991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND emp00_all_title = 0 AND emp00_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_appr_id IN ( SELECT apr01_appr_id FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_status_cd = '30' AND apr01_inout_cd = '10' EXCEPT SELECT apr01_appr_id FROM apr01_appr , sys10_file WHERE apr01_appr_id = sys10_parent_id AND sys10_title_yn = 'true' )
